text: Refti yahron 'Arafaat, hono yimɓe nyeemtinatnooɓe Annabi Ibraahiima ɓen gerdaynoo, hara wanaa hono no yimɓe majjere roŋkiraynoo daragol ɗon. Ɗaɓɓiron haforaneede immorde e Alla kon ko raɓɓindini ɗon e dewe Makko. Pellet Alla ko Haforanoowo kala tuubuɗo e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, Huuɓuɗo yurmeede ɓe.
